name: Gamble or sure thing (supplementary, expectiminimax)
note: Supplementary. MAX chooses the sure MIN node B (value 4) or a gamble: with probability 0.25 the coin leads to MIN node (2,10) (value 2), with probability 0.75 to MIN node (8,9) (value 8). Expectiminimax: 0.25*2 + 0.75*8 = 6.5, so MAX gambles. Wrong shortcuts in the last caption: treating the coin as an opponent gives 4 (picks the sure thing), as a friend 8, as an unweighted average 5. Only the probability-weighted expectation is right.
